mac-control-mcp captures windows and the screen on behalf of the MCP client (Claude Code, etc) to let an AI agent see and analyse on-screen content.
mac-control-mcp automates other apps (menus, browser JS, volume, dark mode) via AppleScript.
mac-control-mcp reads and controls UI elements across all apps to let an AI agent drive macOS.
mac-control-mcp searches your Desktop via Spotlight to help the AI agent find files you've just saved there.
mac-control-mcp searches your Documents folder via Spotlight so the AI agent can locate files you've stored there.
mac-control-mcp searches your Downloads folder via Spotlight so the AI agent can locate files you've just downloaded.
